summaries.Romania: Romania faces political gridlock as President Nicușor Dan seeks a premier designation before a US visit, with negotiations stalled between PSD, PNL, and UDMR over government formation. The interim PM Ilie Bolojan signals openness to early elections while highlighting urgent budget and energy crises requiring immediate governmental action.
